paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4 as of 2026-08-14, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions.

Fermi Inc. received a subpoena from a US District Court for certain documents related to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas, according to a news headline from Bloomberg. This news was reported on 2026-08-14, and there was one new news item in the last 24 hours.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary. There was also one Form 4 filing in the feed.
